action_items: (LOW design) Mobile /admin/predictions: stack 'Generate (Cached)' + 'Force Re-Generate' buttons under the heading on viewports <420px, currently the second button is clipped off-screen.

(carry-over HIGH from iter_3, not retested this round) Wrap LiteLLM/emergentintegrations calls inside `await asyncio.to_thread(...)` in /app/backend/pipeline.py to avoid event-loop starvation during /slip/generate?force=true.
(carry-over MED from iter_2) Brute-force lockout still uses per-pod identifier, may not trip behind K8s ingress.
critical_code_review_comments: scheduler.py L74: `user_filter={'user_id': 'admin'}` filters subscriptions by user_id='admin' literal string, but db.push_subscriptions stores the actual UUID of the admin user (from auth_required dependency). This admin-only push notification will NEVER find a match — admin-only cron-completion broadcast is effectively dead code. Either resolve admin user_id at runtime or use a role flag in the subscription doc.

server.py L324: `if code != (existing.get('code') or '')` — broadcast fires only when code CHANGES, but if admin clicks Publish Code with same value twice in a row only the first triggers. Fine intentionally, but worth a one-line comment in code.
push_service.py L142: `asyncio.gather(...)` with 5000-sub batch could DoS the event loop. Add concurrency cap (asyncio.Semaphore(50)) for production safety.
saas_models.py: `cron_hour_utc: int = 8` — no Pydantic validator restricting to 0-23, allowing values like 99 to silently break CronTrigger. Add `Field(ge=0, le=23)`.

AdminConfig POST silently swallows masked secret values (good) but does not trim/validate odds_api_base_url; an admin pasting a base URL with trailing whitespace or trailing slash inconsistencies could break /v4 endpoint composition downstream.
/api/push/subscribe: no rate-limit. A trial user could spam thousands of subscription docs via crafted endpoints. Add unique-index already exists on endpoint but consider per-user cap of N subs.

rca of the issue: No new critical bugs surfaced this iteration. Latent dead-code issue: scheduler._run_daily_pipeline post-completion broadcast uses `user_filter={'user_id': 'admin'}` which never matches the real admin's UUID in db.push_subscriptions — admin will never receive the 'slip is ready, please publish SportyBet code' notification from the cron path. Reproduction: subscribe as admin, wait for cron 08:00 UTC, observe no push; mitigation: lookup admin's id via `await db.users.find_one({'role':'admin'},{'id':1})` and pass `{'user_id': admin_doc['id']}`.
